title: grammitis sikkimensis
intro: Grammitis sikkimensis, commonly known as the Sikkim grammitis fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is native to the Himalayan region and has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits. The plant is known to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Grammitis sikkimensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
